author: IGN
description:
In today's Daily Fix:
Phantom Blade Zero has sold around one million pre-launch copies worldwide. This comes from Alinea Analytics, who says that S-GAME's wuxia-inspired action game has sold 850,000 copies in the West on Steam and PS5, and another quarter million from Tencent's WeGame (a Chinese-only digital storefront). The game is reviewing well, too, with IGN scoring it a 9. In other news, PlayStation has revealed their PS Plus lineup for November, which includes Dead Island 2, Tomb Raider IV-VI Remastered, and Monster Train 2. And we’re riding Mine Cart Madness inside Super Nintendo World with The Ride Guys at Universal Epic Universe at Universal Orlando Resort.
Presented by Universal Orlando Resort and its newest theme park, Universal Epic Universe.
title: Phantom Blade Zero Is a Hit With One Million Presale Copies Sold - IGN Daily Fix

author: IGN
description:
Fifteen years after Pooh, Tigger, and Rabbit are captured and turned into attractions for the sinister Woozles Circus, orphaned teenager Momo Milne begins searching for her missing mother. Following a clue linking her mother’s disappearance to the circus, Momo and her best friend Billie take jobs inside the bizarre traveling show to uncover the truth.

Behind the bright lights and carnival magic, they discover a nightmare: the circus hides monstrous half-human creatures, violent secrets, and a trail of missing victims. As Pooh and the others struggle under cruel captivity, their bloodthirsty instincts begin to resurface, turning the carnival into a slaughterhouse.

Trapped inside a deadly world of twisted fairy tales and brutal horrors, Momo must unravel the connection between her mother and the circus before she and Billie become the next victims of the Woozles’ terrifying show.

The cast includes Roger L. Jackson, Richard Stanley, Josephine Blazier, Scott Chambers, Kira Reed, Leo Ha
title: Winnie-the-Pooh: Blood and Honey 3 - Exclusive Red Band Trailer (2027) Josephine Blazier

Unbeknownst to her, Kuroboro’s underground crime bosses see Ten’s release as a threat to their power, and will stop at nothing to eliminate her.

author: IGN
description:
The Wolf Among Us Remastered reviewed by Sarah Thwaites on PC, also available on Xbox, PlayStation, and Switch.

"The Wolf Among Us Remastered revamps Telltale’s beloved episodic adventure, adding neon highlights to its already vivid world full of complex characters. While the pacing still dips slightly toward the end, nuanced performances and heart-pounding quick-time events quickly reel you back in as you bear down on the killer. It’s disappointing that some of the original’s stiff animations haven't been ironed out, but the stunning environmental redesigns and a solid suite of bonus features more than make up for it. Though not entirely definitive, this remaster is a powerful reminder of why The Wolf Among Us earned its acclaim – and with a sequel on the horizon, it's a brilliant way to either revisit or catch up on a neo-noir mystery that still deserves its flowers."
title: The Wolf Among Us Remastered Review
